label: Causal possession bottleneck: mode of possession, the more-such package and the formal gap
summary: Warrant-phase checkpoint on the top substantive bottleneck family (computed ranking in docs/notes/spine-dependency-map.md, 2026-11-27). The unrestricted maxim 376d6a5a ranks first because the distinct-cause version 2c0b9bd7 is derived only through the strength application 777d3b8d or the cycle with 'more such' d5a94eb1; no route consumer uses its self-causation case. Verified: for every single act predicate shared by the possession premise and the exceeding step, the more-such package with the bearer c11369aa read formally implies formal distinct-cause possession (moreSuchPackageForcesFormalPossession, premise-free). Verified controls shaped like induction heating: with a stipulated workpiece-hotter comparative (not MORE_3) and with MORE_3 as the frame comparative at the respect of having some heat, the inclusive exceeding step 7030af77 is the member of the package that fails; formal possession fails only at a degree-indexed respect; the formal reading of 'nothing moves except as in act' fails at the degree-indexed respect (respect 2) and holds at having some heat. MORE_3 and MORE_4 are registered senses of the MORE disambiguation; the ordinary-comparative gap e7db0c0f is the alternative to, and a typed attack on, the MORE_3 sibling 31b55b01 of 'more such' (not d5a94eb1 itself), warranted by induction heating stated as standard engineering practice. Rumford's boring trials count at most against the remote drive. Consumer audit (re-checked over all 73 consumers): direct stage-one God-route uses of d5a94eb1 are only at esse, except the older 1dff22d0 and 892db443, which have siblings c201b61a and d0c022f8; stage two also takes preexistence 64498e7e, whose derivation 6b609ddc applies d5a94eb1 at every perfection with a cause of being as cause (pattern E), and all three derivations of 64498e7e share transfer f8ba2429. No premise is established, defeated in the frontier sense, or closed.
blocker: Two checkpoints follow: preexistence 64498e7e (its q.4 a.2 direct option 50df1fd8, the shared transfer premise f8ba2429 and nonuniversal transfer 10cd24ed, and the pattern-E use of 'more such'); and the esse comparative (the order model at esse plus strict primacy, which carry uniqueness by themselves; 18561596 for maximum-as-effect uses, with no independent warrant; the calibration premises behind 7030af77 at esse).

current_assessment.scope: The causal possession family under DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION's CAUSE_2, the DISAMB-IN-ACT senses, the MORE senses of disambiguation cdb0de59 (MORE_1 primitive, MORE_3 ordinary, MORE_4 eminent) and DISAMB-ORDER-OF-BEING at esse; respects fixed as stated in the note (having some heat, a degree-indexed heat respect, or the threshold quality being hot).
current_assessment.assessment: Formal possession 26632e48 is contradicted by induction heating at a degree-indexed respect or the threshold quality 'being hot' (not at 'having some heat'), under the recorded meaning of CAUSE_2; the formal reading of f296a694 fails at the same degree-indexed respect (at 'having some heat' the coil has heat formally), so the prima via needs the uniform inclusive reading. Inclusive possession 2c0b9bd7 is strong prima facie but light (near-analytic on the power determination with instrumental power and no comparative content in 'in a higher way'; the instrument objection stays kept conditionally on a principal-power reading). Stage one: direct God-route uses of d5a94eb1 are only at esse, except the older 1dff22d0 and 892db443, which have siblings c201b61a and d0c022f8; maximum-as-cause uses (pattern A) would be served by PrimaryCauseIsMoreSuchReading at esse only under the open premises ApproachToPrimary at esse and StrictPrimacy, and strict primacy already entails the uniqueness conclusions, so that certificate shifts the load rather than lightening it; the homogeneous-scale fork 528ccadd and 210019ee applies the premise to every distinct cause (A+B); maximum-as-effect uses (pattern B) need 18561596, which has no independent warrant. Stage two also takes preexistence 64498e7e; all three of its derivations share unrestricted transfer f8ba2429, and 6b609ddc applies 'more such' at every perfection with a cause of being as cause (pattern E). Induction does not reach that use (the coil causes no being); read with MORE_3 it would require causes of being to have every effect perfection formally at a higher degree, which conflicts with the route's own eminence account, and read with MORE_4 it is unspecified. The MORE_3 sibling 31b55b01 of 'more such' and the inclusive exceeding step with MORE_3 are contradicted by the case (checked in ordinaryControls); the typed attack targets the sibling, not d5a94eb1. The mixed reading is excluded. 376d6a5a is unchanged. First grades; no earlier judgment outside this attempt is revised.

assessment_history.assessment: Formal possession 26632e48 is contradicted by induction heating at a degree-indexed respect or the threshold quality 'being hot' (not at 'having some heat'), under the recorded meaning of CAUSE_2; it is not a candidate reading for the routes, and the formal reading of f296a694 fails in the same case, so the prima via needs the uniform inclusive reading. Inclusive possession 2c0b9bd7 is strong prima facie but light: on the power determination of IN_ACT_2, with power including an instrument's transient power and 'in a higher way' read without comparative content, it is near-analytic with no substantive objection identified; restricted to a principal agent's own power the instrument objection stays kept conditionally. 'More such' d5a94eb1 on MORE_3 and the inclusive exceeding step 7030af77 with MORE_3 are contradicted by the same case (typed attack from e7db0c0f); no record specifies MORE_4 at arbitrary r under which d5a94eb1 holds for every distinct cause, and the one recorded analogical order certifies it only with the primary as cause (29133b2b). The consumer audit changes the weight for the God routes: their consumers apply d5a94eb1 only at esse, so their load is the esse comparative (cffad050, its exceeding step at esse and the calibration premises it is derived from), not the arbitrary-r comparative; maximum-as-cause uses are certified on the attribution order with the primary as cause, maximum-as-effect uses need the open claim that a maximum has no distinct cause of its being. The arbitrary-r package stays load-bearing only for preexistence 6b609ddc and the Cartesian containment results. The mixed reading is excluded by moreSuchPackageForcesFormalPossession with the formal gap. 376d6a5a is unchanged. First grades; no earlier judgment is revised.
